slots.intro.lead: No two gaming experiences are the same. Different genres, audiences, platforms and ambitions require different expertise.
slots.intro.body:
Shakuri brings together creative, strategy, production, marketing and ongoing management under one roof, supported by a global network of specialist development partners.

From immersive brand worlds and competitive sports games to RPGs, simulators and social experiences, we assemble the right combination of talent for each project.

Our partnership model also allows us to deliver experiences across multiple gaming platforms, including Roblox, Fortnite and soon GTA, matching the right technical expertise and creative approach to each platform’s unique opportunities.

This flexible approach gives brands access to proven expertise across genres and platforms, while Shakuri provides the creative direction, production oversight and strategic thinking that brings everything together.
